rationale: This is the fourth pass at "profitability × retained-earnings deficit" in the archive (Margin Repair, Asset Profit Rebound, Deficit Cash-Runway), and replacing the profitability level with a coarse 0–5 profitable-year count is a cosmetic reformulation that adds little cross-sectional resolution while remaining close to the published distress/profitability interaction.

The construct is essentially the sign-flipped, oiadp→re substituted version of the archive's Unfunded R&D Loss Pressure and, more importantly, is dominated by R&D-intensity level interacted with financial-constraint/cash proxies — a direct restatement of the documented R&D-and-financial-constraints and cash-holdings-with-R&D premia rather than a new mechanism.

This is the third instance of the identical triple product RANK(sales growth) × RANK(weak profitability) × RANK((lct−act)/at) already tested twice in the archive (Distress-Funded Low-Margin Growth, Liquidity-Stressed Unprofitable Expansion), with only the profitability leg swapped, so it cannot deliver substantively new information.

Because asset-scaled interest expense is an order of magnitude smaller than asset-scaled gross profit, the "shortfall" leg is numerically almost pure negative gross profitability, so the signal reduces to a leverage-tilted repackaging of the well-known gross-profitability anomaly rather than the interest-coverage mechanism claimed.

Since (revt−cogs)−xsga is operating income before depreciation, DELTA(xsga/at − GP/at) is mechanically ≈ −DELTA(oibdp/at), making this a sign-flipped duplicate of the archive's change-in-operating-profitability × liquidity-stress signals rather than the distinct "cost absorption" construct described.

target_name: Profitable Cash Rebuild Under Current Debt
rationale: The cash-accumulation leg is a genuinely new profitability-theme input for this archive and the triple conditioning on operating profitability and current debt is economically coherent with a consistent expected sign, though the change-in-cash component overlaps with known cash-holdings/accrual effects and the signed-value × rank product will make the long-short spread partly a rank-composite sort.
